did: Built and tested live in the browser pane by hand. A signed-in buyer with market orders opened the market home.

checks.text: At the very top of the market home a Picked for you row shows eight products, each with its photo, name and price, scrolling sideways on a phone

The products come from what this buyer ordered or saved: the same categories first, then the same kind of business and the same sellers, with products that sold more in the last 90 days a little ahead

What they already bought, their own products, sold-out products, hidden products and cancelled orders are left out; one buyer's history is never used for another; a buyer with no history sees nothing there
It shows only on the plain market page, not inside a shop, a category or a search, and a sale price shows on the card like anywhere else (automatic tests)

notes: Built this round from the spec (chapter 13). It is the plain, explainable kind, worked out from order and saved-product history; no learning model and no outside service. Not built: a switch for a buyer to turn it off, and recommendations in the pharmacy or food sections. 8 new automatic tests.

shots.caption: Picked for you, at the top of the market
